content: Co-occurrence bias is computed from the model-generated texts by comparing the occurrences of all gender-neutral words with female and male words. A word is considered to be biased towards a certain gender if it occurs more frequently with words of that gender. This definition was first used by BIBREF7 and later adapted by BIBREF5 . Using the definition of gender bias similar to the one used by BIBREF5 , we define gender bias as INLINEFORM0
